The plate looks like a square side plate of roughly 24 cm. The food on it is scrambled egg whites or egg-white curds plus two thin strips of bacon.

The egg pile covers about 8 x 8 cm and is roughly 2 cm thick, so I estimate about 80 g. Egg white is about 50 kcal per 100 g, so that is about 45 kcal.

The two bacon strips are probably about 8 g in total once cooked, which is roughly 45 kcal.

Together that comes to about 90 kcal and about 90 g. I'll round the energy up slightly to allow for any oil used in cooking.
